POWER MECHANICS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #1
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: POWER MECHANICS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Assembly drawing and Sectioning, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Assembly drawing and Sectioning.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Assembly drawing and Sectioning.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Assembly drawing and Sectioning.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Assembly drawing and Sectioning.

2. When learning Motor Vehicle batteries, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Motor Vehicle batteries.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Motor Vehicle batteries.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Motor Vehicle batteries.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Motor Vehicle batteries.

3. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. International Cricket Team
   B. Input Cable Tester
   C. Internal Cooking Timer
   D. Information and Communication Technology

4. When learning electronic systems, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for electronic systems.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for electronic systems.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after electronic systems.
   D. Skip safety briefings for electronic systems.

5. When learning Electrical Systems 3.2 Electronic Systems 3.3 Vehicle transmission systems 3.4 O, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Electrical Systems 3.2 Electronic Systems 3.3 Vehicle transmission systems 3.4 O.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Electrical Systems 3.2 Electronic Systems 3.3 Vehicle transmission systems 3.4 O.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Electrical Systems 3.2 Electronic Systems 3.3 Vehicle transmission systems 3.4 O.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Electrical Systems 3.2 Electronic Systems 3.3 Vehicle transmission systems 3.4 O.

6. When learning Surface Developmen t of prisms, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Surface Developmen t of prisms.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Surface Developmen t of prisms.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Surface Developmen t of prisms.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Surface Developmen t of prisms.

7. When learning Surface Development of pyramids, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Surface Development of pyramids.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Surface Development of pyramids.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Surface Development of pyramids.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Surface Development of pyramids.

8. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Monitor
   B. Keyboard
   C. Speaker
   D. CPU

9. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Remove all guards
   B. Wear safety gear and follow instructions
   C. Run with the tool
   D. Work alone with eyes closed

10. When learning Vehicle transmission systems 3.4 Oxy acetylene welding in motor vehicles 4. Engi, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Vehicle transmission systems 3.4 Oxy acetylene welding in motor vehicles 4. Engi.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Vehicle transmission systems 3.4 Oxy acetylene welding in motor vehicles 4. Engi.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Vehicle transmission systems 3.4 Oxy acetylene welding in motor vehicles 4. Engi.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Vehicle transmission systems 3.4 Oxy acetylene welding in motor vehicles 4. Engi.

11. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   B. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   C. Ignore burnt cables
   D. Overload every socket

12. When learning Introduction to computer aided drawing, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Introduction to computer aided drawing.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Introduction to computer aided drawing.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Introduction to computer aided drawing.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Introduction to computer aided drawing.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Surface Development of pyramids and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Assembly drawing and Sectioning and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Introduction to computer aided drawing and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Electrical Systems 3.2 Electronic Systems 3.3 Vehicle transmission systems 3.4 O and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
MARKING SCHEME
====

1. C — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Assembly drawing and Sectioning.

2. B — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Motor Vehicle batteries.

3. D — Information and Communication Technology

4. A — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for electronic systems.

5. A — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Electrical Systems 3.2 Electronic Systems 3.3 Vehicle transmission systems 3.4 O.

6. D — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Surface Developmen t of prisms.

7. C — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Surface Development of pyramids.

8. D — CPU

9. B — Wear safety gear and follow instructions

10. C — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Vehicle transmission systems 3.4 Oxy acetylene welding in motor vehicles 4. Engi.

11. A — Never touch live wires with wet hands

12. A — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Introduction to computer aided drawing.

13. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Surface Development of pyramids; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

14. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Assembly drawing and Sectioning; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

15. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Introduction to computer aided drawing; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Electrical Systems 3.2 Electronic Systems 3.3 Vehicle transmission systems 3.4 O; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
